changelog: Adds a live buffer meter and playback-status icons when you press Select or tap during playback. Shows your active buffer mode, actual seconds buffered, measured live delay and its target. Updates the readout twice per second for six seconds, with clear short-window and unavailable-time labels. Clarifies buffer setting descriptions and receiver-managed Cast buffering. Includes the B.C. game-time correction from 2.3.4.
